text:
Mira Chen: heads-up — a 7B chat model we just converted from HF is producing weird context drift after ~1k tokens. looks like an attention kv mismatch. :thinking_face:

Tom Alvarez: can you paste the conversion command and the config.json you saw?

Mira Chen: sure. command was: `rw-convert --from hf --to redwood ./hf-checkpoints/galaxy-7b ./rw-models/galaxy-7b`

Mira Chen: snippet from the HF config.json (original):
```
"num_attention_heads": 64,
"num_key_value_heads": 32,
"max_position_embeddings": 4096,
"rope_scaling": {"type": "linear", "factor": 1.0},
"sliding_window": true
```

Mira Chen: after conversion the runtime config ended up as: 
```
"num_attention_heads": 64,
// MISSING num_key_value_heads => converter left it unset
"max_position_embeddings": 2048,  // truncated by conversion default
"rope_scaling": null,
"sliding_window": false
```

Mira Chen: runtime warning we saw: `KV cache head mismatch: expected 32, got 64` and then generation starts repeating older context and hallucinating end-of-sequence tokens. :grimacing:

Jess K: ugh. looks like the converter applied a default max_position_embeddings and dropped num_key_value_heads. some HF models use grouped KV heads (num_kv = num_heads/2) and converter should map that.

Tom Alvarez: is the tokenizer length hitting the trimmed 2048? that would also explain context reset.

Mira Chen: tokenizer encodes a long prompt ~3500 tokens, we see truncation and fallback to caching strategy that assumes no sliding window. so two bugs: (1) missing num_key_value_heads mapping, (2) sliding_window flag lost, (3) rope_scaling not propagated => rotary pos embedding mismatch. all together cause stutter.

Siva Narayanan: quick mitigation: re-run conversion with explicit override flags: `--set num_key_value_heads=32 --set max_position_embeddings=4096 --set sliding_window=true --set rope_scaling='{"type":"linear","factor":1.0}'`

Siva Narayanan: longer-term: converter should implement heuristics and sanity checks:
- if `num_key_value_heads` missing, infer from `num_attention_heads` (try /2, then fallback to equal)
- if `max_position_embeddings` < tokenizer longest sequence, emit a warning and preserve original HF value
- copy rope_scaling block verbatim when present, and assert numeric types
- preserve sliding_window boolean or translate to `kv_cache_mode: sliding` vs `kv_cache_mode: continuous`

Jess K: +1. also add a conversion unit test: load an HF config with `num_key_value_heads` omitted but with `num_attention_heads=64` and assert converter outputs `num_key_value_heads=32`. Caught similar in past with llama-ish variants.

Mira Chen: I ran a manual patch to the converted `config.json` and restarted the model — generation looks stable now through 4k tokens. patch was literally adding `"num_key_value_heads": 32` and restoring `max_position_embeddings: 4096` and `sliding_window: true`. rope_scaling -> copied back and fixed.

convert-bot: Conversion run 1709001234 -> status: partial-success. Warnings emitted: ["num_key_value_heads missing; inferred 32","max_position_embeddings downgraded to 2048 (user override available)","rope_scaling not found; defaulting to null"]

Tom Alvarez: can you drop the broken converted config and the working patched config into the model directory (`/rw-models/galaxy-7b/configs/`) so I can add a converter regression test?

Mira Chen: done — uploaded `config.converted.json` (original converted) and `config.patched.json` (working) to the model dir. link: https://internal.redwood/models/galaxy-7b/configs (private). :white_check_mark:

Siva Narayanan: I'll open a small PR on the converter with the heuristics and add the unit tests. plan: 1) infer num_kv when absent, 2) preserve rope_scaling blob, 3) fail-fast if max_position_embeddings < tokenizer.max_len. assigning to myself, will ping when PR is ready.

Jess K: please include a short integration test that runs a 3k token generation and checks no KV head mismatch warnings.

Mira Chen: thanks all. leaving the patched model running for 24h smoke tests and will report regressions. :coffee:

Tom Alvarez: nice catch. this one was subtle because individually these fields are small, but together they break the serving semantics. :eyes:

convert-bot: PR suggestion: add conversion log entry `preserved_fields: ["rope_scaling","sliding_window","num_key_value_heads","max_position_embeddings"]` when possible.

Siva Narayanan: noted. will include the log entry and a converter CLI flag `--preserve-unsafe` to force preserving fields verbatim.

Mira Chen: if anyone wants repro steps I can paste a minimal prompt that triggers the drift. otherwise i'll update the incident board after the 24h run.

Tom Alvarez: pls paste the minimal prompt (just in case).

Mira Chen: minimal repro (shortened):
```
SYSTEM: You are a helpful assistant that must keep context.
USER: <3500-token doc of product spec...>
USER: Summarize the above and list open questions.
```
With broken config it repeats the first paragraph repeatedly after ~900 tokens. With patched config it continues to summarize correctly through 4k tokens.

Jess K: great debug thread. logging these notes into the conversion docs page.
